integrity: A standalone brute-force verifier and a separate symbolic enumerator agree over stated finite ranges; these computations do not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only second powers of ordered paths; no independent priority or scientific audit; an adjacent injective-coloring paper was abstract-only. General proper interval graph optimization is already algorithmically tractable.
title: Edge-open-packing polynomial and six-phase optimum census for squared paths
